thread:
Maya: FYI support flagged a tenant where console shows route pinned to v2 but the runtime served v1 for ~3k requests overnight.
Ibrahim: Is this the header-less client case again?
Maya: Looks like it. They use an old SDK that doesn't set X-Api-Version. Runtime fallback rule selected v1 variant because of seqlen heuristic.
Rae: Can we at least make the mismatch visible to tenants? They're getting billed for v2 rates but the CPU/latency is v1
Nora: Wait billing attached to requested route? That would be wrong. Where is cost attribution wired today?
Ibrahim: Console currently attributes tokens to the requested_route header. We never switched to served variant because "requested" matched most traffic historically.
Maya: Support ticket example: tenant T-3202 saw latency improve but bill stayed high since console thought v2 tokens were used. Confusing for SRE and customer.
Rae: Short term patch ideas: runtime returns X-Served-Version in response; billing pipeline reads served header for attribution if present; console shows both requested/served columns.
Ibrahim: Also emit metric routing.version_mismatch{tenant,served,requested} so we can alert on noise. Alert if mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 30m per tenant.
Nora: Agree. Add fallback_reason tag: header_missing | legacy_sdk | seqlen_incompatible | capacity. That will help triage.
Maya: UX: per-tenant banner "Requests sometimes routed to a different API version. Click to see sample request ids." Also allow toggling "strict-version-enforce" (fail requests when header missing) for a tenant for 14 days.
Rae: Be careful with strict enforcement -- will break lots of clients. Make it opt-in and include link to migration docs + SDK upgrade.
Ibrahim: Implementation plan: (1) quick canary that returns X-Served-Version + X-Fallback-Reason when mismatch (2) add metrics in scribe (3) console change to read served_version for billing when flag 'billing_use_served_version' enabled (4) backfill billing for last 48h where supported.
Maya: Any privacy or leakage concerns with adding headers?
Nora: We already surface model and region headers in responses. Small risk but ok. Must document in release notes and security review.
Rae: Backfill plan: create conservative correction job, run on tenants with >1% mismatch and potential bill delta >$100. Finance to approve credits for affected tenants.
Ibrahim: We'll need a migration script to reconcile invoices. I'll coordinate with finance and support.
ops-bot: rollout started: routing-proxy v3.4.1 -> canary 10% (initiated by Ibrahim)
Maya: Monitor metrics routing.version_mismatch and billing.delta_by_tenant. If mismatch persists beyond 2h, rollback canary.
Nora: I'll prep support template and FAQ wording. Also add a KB for finance on how we calculate backfill adjustments.
Rae: Could we add a console timeline view showing when served changed vs requested? That helps customers debug their SDKs.
Ibrahim: Good idea. Console should mark request samples with served_version and fallback_reason. We'll attach request_id links to logs.
Maya: I'll open the small RFC with config flags and console mock. ETA for mock: 3h. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Nora: Looping in billing and eng-sre for alert rules + any possible invoice impact.
